title: Credit reservoir reset atomicity and telemetry for reserved-capacity monthly windows
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Reserved-capacity tenants occasionally observe misaligned monthly quota resets after DST changes, leader failovers, or cross-region clock drift. Root cause analysis from prior incidents shows non-atomic credit reservoir resets combined with partial ledger writes and racey lease renewals can temporarily allow double-spend or cause tenants to lose a day's worth of credits.

Goal: Implement an atomic, observable monthly reset workflow for reserved-capacity credit reservoirs that: 1) guarantees at-most-once reset semantics per-tenant per-window, 2) produces detailed audit records for every step (pre-snapshot, swap, and reconciliation), and 3) exposes telemetry to quickly detect partial resets or long-running reconcile jobs.

Approach: Introduce a two-phase reset pattern with a short-lived reset lease and an idempotent swap operation on the billing ledger: (a) Acquire a per-tenant reset lease (TTL ~60s) in the cluster-level coordination service; (b) take a pre-reset snapshot of the reservoir and write an immutable audit entry; (c) perform an atomic compare-and-swap on the ledger row (serializable txn or strong compare-exchange) to set the new monthly allowance and mark the reservoir as RESET_APPLIED with reset_id; (d) emit a post-reset audit entry and ledger delta; (e) release lease. If lease cannot be acquired, defer and retry with exponential backoff; if a partial reset is detected (pre without post or vice-versa), a reconciliation job will perform safe rollforward or rollback using the audit trail.

Telemetry and Alerts: Create a dashboard with per-tenant reset state transitions, latency histogram for reset operations, and a health metric for reconciliation lag. Add alerting rules: (1) Any tenant with pre-snapshot but no post entry after 120s -> P1 pager, (2) reconciliation backlog > 5 tenants for >10m -> P1.

Acceptance criteria: (a) Unit and integration tests simulating concurrent resets, failovers, and clock adjustments; (b) End-to-end canary run against a synthetic tenant set with injected leader failover and DST shift showing no double-spend and correct remaining credits; (c) Observability: dashboard surfaces transition breadcrumbs for at least 90% of resets, and alerting fires for simulated partial-reset scenarios; (d) Runbook and rollback documented and validated in staging.
comments: 2025-11-03 — Asha created ticket after postmortem for INC-2025-11-01 (reserved-tenant reset drift). Initial proposal sketched in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/BILL/Reset+Atomicity+Proposal

2025-11-10 — Design review with PM & Payments: decided on short-lived per-tenant lease (vs global window lock) to limit blast radius. Marco to prototype lease acquisition and compare-exchange flow. Action: design doc link -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=78654

2025-11-18 — Prototype complete: implemented lease + tx swap in local env. Ran fault-injection (kill leader mid-swap): observed pre-snapshot written without post entry in 0.2% of runs. Added reconciliation plan to reconcile using immutable audit entries. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/2413
2025-11-25 — Security review kickoff completed; KMS use for audit record signing approved. Security notes: audit entries must be HMAC-tagged before writing to audit_db (see doc).

2025-12-02 — Telemetry spike: added reset_state transitions and latency histograms to console dashboard (staging). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/reset-reservoirs-staging. Early telemetry shows median reset latency 150ms, P99 2.1s in staging under load.

2025-12-08 — Integration tests: simulated DST forward/back shifts and cross-region failover; reconciliation job fixed 100% of partial states in test harness. Preparing canary run plan and runbook. Canary target tenants: 30 synthetic reserved tenants across two regions.

2025-12-10 — Ready for canary. Deployed to staging/alpha. Canary playbook written in runbook doc (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-reset-runbook. Next: coordinate with SRE for on-call coverage during production canary (2025-12-12).
